title.narrative: Yunnan Lincang Border Economic Cooperation Zone Development Project

description.narrative: The project will address cross-border trade capacity, border connectivity, and urban and social development issues in the Cangyuan Wa, Gengma Dai and Wa, and Zhenkang counties in Lincang Prefecture; and support Yunnan Province in enhancing regional cooperation and integration (RCI) under the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS) program, focusing on economic corridor development. It is expected to enhance RCI in the Shan border province of Myanmar by providing benefits to Myanmar nationals who trade, work, and use social services in the project counties.
